this_week.title: Creative Director
this_week.why: Solid pay and fully remote, but it's a contract gig focused narrowly on performance-marketing/GenAI ad production for Meta's SMB audience, not his strategic brand-campaign strength.
red_flags: Contract through 3/31/27 via staffing agency, not FTE
Scope is narrow performance-marketing/digital ads, not integrated brand leadership
Only 5-8 yrs experience required, mismatched with his 30-year seniority
